Title: ECS Design Lab: Plan Smart, Learn Smart
Description:
ECS Design Lab: Plan Smart, Learn Smart
This session is open to any ECS Student.  Students in ECS 101 are required to attend this workshop ONCE

Join the Success Advising team to tackle the two most practical levers students have over their academic performance: how they organize their time and how they actually study. Students will build a personalized semester blueprint that carves out realistic time for coursework, deadlines, and life — then immediately put that time to work by learning evidence-based study techniques that improve retention and comprehension. The session is designed so that each skill reinforces the other: a schedule without strong study habits is just a calendar, and good study strategies don't work if you never protected the time to use them.

Title: ECS Design Lab: Build Your Foundation
Description:
ECS Design Lab: Build Your Foundation
This session is open to any ECS Student.  Students in ECS 101 are required to attend this workshop ONCE

Academic success rarely happens alone, and it rarely happens without setbacks. This workshop addresses both truths at once. Students will explore how to identify and activate the people and resources around them — peers, faculty, and campus services — while also building the internal tools to bounce back when things get hard. The session frames resilience not as toughness or pushing through alone, but as knowing yourself well enough to seek the right support at the right moment. Together, community-building and resilience form the foundation that keeps students moving forward even when a semester gets difficult.
